one_line: Telugu poet–historian of the Thanjavur Nayaka court and scholar of the Sarasvati Mahal manuscript world.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s to early-30s, slender but sturdy build, graceful posture of a court scholar
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown South Indian complexion, large thoughtful anime-style eyes with dark irises, straight brows, fine nose, soft but serious mouth; default expression calm, observant and slightly intent, as if weighing words and power.
appearance.hair: long, thick black hair oiled and neatly parted in the middle, drawn back into a low bun at the nape, wrapped with a thin gold-threaded cloth band; a small vermilion bindi at the centre of her forehead; no crown, only a simple gold maang-tikka style ornament resting just at the hairline.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early 17th-century South Indian court attire: a full-length cotton-silk sari in deep maroon with fine gold borders and subtle floral motifs, draped in a modest South Indian style covering both shoulders and torso fully; underneath, an elbow-length fitted blouse of muted mustard-yellow silk; the sari’s lower pleats fall to the ankles and are slightly flared for movement; she wears a simple set of gold jewellery—small round stud earrings, a medium-length gold chain necklace with a tiny pendant, two thin gold bangles on each wrist, and a plain gold ring; around her waist a narrow woven belt-like sari fold gives structure; her feet are in flat brown leather sandals typical of the period; overall look practical yet dignified, clearly of a learned woman in a royal court rather than a heavily ornamented queen.
appearance.signature: A palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with cotton cord and a slim stylus (metal or wood) held together in her right hand, the leaves etched with faint script lines, symbolising her role as author and interpreter of dynastic history.

ref_desc: Ramabhadramba is a medium-brown, oval-faced woman with large thoughtful eyes, long black hair in a low bun, maroon sari with gold borders over mustard blouse, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and always carries a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus in warm maroon–gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Ramabhadramba: a dignified early-17th-century South Indian court scholar, medium-brown complexion, oval face, large dark eyes and calm, observant expression. Her long black hair is oiled, centre-parted, and gathered into a low bun at the nape, wrapped with a thin gold-threaded band, with a tiny gold ornament at the hairline and a small vermilion bindi on her forehead. She wears a full-length deep maroon cotton-silk sari with fine gold borders and subtle floral motifs, draped modestly to cover both shoulders and torso completely, over an elbow-length fitted mustard-yellow silk blouse; the sari’s pleats fall to her ankles. Small round gold stud earrings, a simple gold chain necklace with tiny pendant, two thin gold bangles on each wrist, and a plain gold ring give understated courtly elegance. At her waist the drape forms a neat, narrow fold like a belt, and she stands in flat brown leather sandals. In her right hand she firmly holds her signature prop: a tied bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts with a slim stylus, the etched lines of script just visible, emphasising her identity as a poet–historian and interpreter of power. Show her from multiple angles with consistent maroon, mustard, warm gold, medium brown and black tones, capturing a poised, scholarly energy suitable for a Thanjavur Nayaka court setting.
